proposed_rules.trigger: A case-study page whose entire post-title content is captured as a single oversized leaf node (several thousand px tall) with only a truncated text preview and no distinct heading/paragraph/image children.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted DOM extraction to recover the actual paragraph/heading/pull-quote/image structure before mapping to default-content; do not conclude the article is literally one paragraph.
proposed_rules.rationale: minWidth/visual-tree capture flattens long-form rich-text bodies into one text node when internal elements lack strong layout breaks. Recurs identically across all sampled case-study pages (C73, C74, C75), reinforcing it is a capture artifact, not per-page content.
